xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3451: pi/ohmypi extensions still gate work-complete evidence on .beads/issues.jsonl (dead since PAN-2648)

plan.title: pi/ohmypi extensions still gate work-complete evidence on .beads/issues.jsonl (dead since PAN-2648)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: evidenceClean() in packages/pi-extension/src/index.ts:499 and packages/ohmypi-extension/src/index.ts:506 gates the evidence-clean work-complete path on allIssueBeadsClosed(), which reads <workspace>/.beads/issues.jsonl. Since PAN-2648 removed the beads engine, that file never exists, the read always throws, and the path can never fire. The adjacent xbriefSatisfied() check reads pre-PAN-2541 legacy paths (.pan/spec.vbrief.json, .pan/continue.json) and passes vacuously.
narratives.Proposal: Add POST /api/agents/:id/plan-checklist to the dashboard runtime-events routes: internal-token authenticated, resolves the agent's workspace/issueId from the agent runtime record via getAgentState, and reports checklist completeness through checkIncompletePlanItemsPromise (the canonical door runVerificationForIssue uses). Both extensions replace evidenceClean() with a postJsonWithTimeout call to that endpoint (fail-soft: any error = not clean, falls through to markers/classifier), delete isClosedBead/beadMatchesIssue/allIssueBeadsClosed/statusComplete/planItemsComplete/xbriefSatisfied, and swap beads-flavored strings ('all beads closed' -> 'all tasks closed'; new work-complete summary). docs/HOOKS.md Pi Completion Detection updated.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing runVerificationForIssue() or the pan done preflight (already on the canonical door)
- Changing classify-completion heuristics or the OVERDECK_WORK_COMPLETE / OVERDECK_SPECIALIST_RESULT protocols
- Removing historical bead mentions that document the beads migration itself (docs/ohmypi-contract.md)
- Claude Code Stop-hook completion flow (unaffected)
- Bootstrapping the repo-wide .pan/context/codebase/ map (absent on main; deferred rather than fabricated from a three-file discovery)

autoDecisions.summary: Server-side checklist endpoint instead of mirroring readWorkspacePlanSync in the extensions or shelling out to `pan task`
autoDecisions.rationale: The canonical resolution (projects.yaml lookup, state read home, spec filename parsing, record statusOverrides) is too much machinery to duplicate into two zero-dependency forks without creating a parallel read path for canonical state, which the one-read-door tenet forbids; the extension already owns an authenticated HTTP channel to the dashboard. The issue's proposed fix explicitly names readWorkspacePlan() semantics and the checkIncompletePlanItemsPromise gate — the endpoint is that door, called remotely.

autoDecisions.summary: Endpoint resolves workspace/issueId from the agent runtime record, not the request body
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids trusting client-supplied paths on an authenticated but agent-reachable surface; getAgentState is the pattern sibling routes already use.

autoDecisions.summary: Also delete xbriefSatisfied/planItemsComplete/statusComplete, not just the three bead helpers
autoDecisions.rationale: xbriefSatisfied reads pre-PAN-2541 legacy paths and is fully subsumed by the endpoint's canonical check; keeping it as an extra AND would add a stale-path false-negative with no upside.

autoDecisions.summary: Swap COMPLETION_PHRASES 'all beads closed' to 'all tasks closed' and update the work-complete summary string
autoDecisions.rationale: Same-file beads residue from PAN-2648; 'all tasks closed' is the phrasing the classify-completion route already recognizes.
The directory is absent on main; writing four canonical architecture files from a three-file surgical discovery would fabricate authority and pollute main. Recorded here rather than silently skipped.

items.title: Add POST /api/agents/:id/plan-checklist route backed by checkIncompletePlanItemsPromise

expected_outputs: plan-checklist.test.ts passes all cases (complete, incomplete, unauthenticated)

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/runtime-events.ts add postAgentPlanChecklistRoute (POST /api/agents/:id/plan-checklist) next to postAgentClassifyCompletionRoute (line 161): validateAgentRuntimeEventAuth, then resolve the agent via getAgentState(id) (dynamic import of lib/agents.js, same style as the handler at line 188), 422 when state.workspace or state.issueId is missing, then run checkIncompletePlanItemsPromise(state.workspace, state.issueId) from src/lib/work/done-preflight.ts and return { success: true, complete: incomplete.length === 0, incomplete }. Register the route in src/dashboard/server/routes/agents.ts directly after postAgentClassifyCompletionRoute (imports ~lines 40-42, route list ~lines 113-115). Add tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/plan-checklist.test.ts following the neighboring route-test setup pattern: temp workspace <tmp>/workspaces/feature-pan-3451/ with .overdeck/spec.vbrief.json exercises the findPlanSync legacy-draft fallback without projects.yaml registration. The exact before/after snippet is in PRD drafts/PAN-3451.md work item 1.

items.title: Given an agent whose workspace plan has every item in a terminal status, a POST with the internal token returns HTTP 200 with { success: true, complete: true }
Given a plan with one pending item, the route returns complete: false and the incomplete array names that item id
Given no internal token, the route rejects the request with a 4xx auth response, matching the sibling runtime-event routes
Given an agent id with no resolvable workspace or issueId, the route returns 422 with a success:false body
